Messages.Author: ben...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
I am very pleased to announce that the V:TES North American
Championship in 2008 will be held in Montreal, Quebec. The organizer
for the event is Richard Blais, and the team includes Hugues Bertrand,
Christian Chénard, Marc Desaulniers, Jean-François Houle, Mathieu
Guimond, Etienne Leblanc, Yam Beauchamp, Charles Lechasseur, and
François de Champlain. The hotel and venue for the NAC will be Le
Nouvel Hotel & Spa Hotel in downtown Montreal (http://
www.lenouvelhotel.com). The cost of a single or double occupancy is
$119 a night, and includes a continental breakfeast every morning.
The cost for registering for the NAC is to be determined, but should
be $40-$50 Canadian. The date for the NAC has yet to be determined.

It is important to note that as per a new law, Americans visiting
Canada will need a passport to enter the country. Information on this
can be found here: http://travel.state.gov/travel/tips/regional/regional_1170.html

The Montreal NAC team will post more detailed information, including
the schedule of events and the Week of Nightmares, as it becomes
available.

- Ben Peal, US National Coordinator
